name: smwmusic-tetris-nes-music
title: Tetris (NES) - Music 1
description:
Although not as famous as chiptune Korobeiniki aka Type-A from the GameBoy version, it's a classic on its own right.

This track is a chiptune remix by Hirozaku Tanaka of Dance of the Suger Plum Fairy by Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky from the theatre performance The Nutcracker.
This specific port is in chiptune style and only makes use of four channels with hardcoded and simple instruments.

Best used for night time fun locations (e.g. a carnival or circus), puzzle levels and switch palaces.

Just be wary of giant vitamin pills dropping on top of you if you take too long.

Requested by 7 up.
